rationale: New Devices-editor capability: v1.80.1 has no equal-spacing magnet, and its alignment guides are indication only (logic.ts alignGuides). The diff adds the resolver module, the drag wiring and the two-gap hint; saved data, View and kiosk are unchanged.

summary.ru: Магнит равного шага в редакторе устройств: маркер встаёт в ряд с тем же интервалом, оба промежутка подсвечены.
summary.en: Equal-spacing magnet in the Device editor: a marker snaps into a row at the same interval, with both gaps highlighted.
